bars.says: On the desert map the player can distinguish walkable sand, buildable ground and sparse living shelter, beneath a fixed sunset whose physical casters cast shade away from the sun.

meant.intent: Land must read as an exposed dry place with useful shelter, rather than an orange overlay hiding an ordinary green map. Physical caster means rock, wall or plant; Mirrak appearance is separately tested. Retuning colour or swapping a valid art variant does not change this comparison.

bars.says: A pawn exposed beside genuine shelter gains more Direct Sun heat than the same pawn under that shelter, while shaded hot air can still overheat it and the ordinary health display explains the danger.

meant.intent: The sun adds felt heat; shelter does not refrigerate the air or create a LongShade disease. This is the same geometric rule at the same position in any biome. Reject if the shade is only cosmetic or falsely promises immunity.
meant.source: Standing Direct Sun ruling, design/RimMandrake/standing_rulings.md §Direct Sun, owner 2026-09-29/2026-10-19.

reject: Shade clears Heatstroke immediately or makes a pawn safe in dangerously hot air.
A health label says Direct Sun but a hidden biome damage effect causes the injury, or the matched sheltered pawn gains the same sun load.

bars.says: Under default fixed-world conditions, the player sees healthy native animals rest in shelter and dash across exposed gaps to the next genuine refuge within their endurance, returning from failed hunts instead of pursuing prey into thermal collapse.

meant.intent: Native adaptation must govern food and hunting as well as idle wander. When a reachable real refuge exists and an animal can act, avoidable AI cooking is failure; false-shade mistakes remain possible and readable. Retuning budgets leaves the behavioural comparison intact. Rest then dash then rest must be visible in ordinary default play, including thermally mild crossings; absence of heat injury alone cannot satisfy this bar. Dash means a brisk crossing compared with the same native's ordinary open-ground wandering on comparable terrain, not a required animation, fixed speed or teleport. Body-specific endurance and needs may change when crossings occur, not erase the pattern.
meant.source: Owner strict animal dashing, design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/longshade_shade_ideation_2026-09-29.md §0; later colonist/animal distinction in design/RimMandrake/designer_codex_2026-11-09/LongShade/ANSWERS_OWNER.md answer 1.

accept: A healthy grazer rests in real shelter, crosses an exposed gap more briskly than its ordinary wandering gait, then rests in the next refuge; a Dakkra abandons a fleeing target to reach real shelter and recover.

In mild default sunlight, healthy natives still alternate shelter rest with brisk exposed crossings instead of spending their ordinary movement wandering over open sand.
reject: An idle animal performs a convincing dash, then its eating or hunting job ignores heat and walks past reachable refuge until it collapses.
An exhausted hunter keeps its burst advantage and pursues across the open while its shelter-rest job never runs.
Natives graze and wander across open sand like vanilla animals, never visibly resting between runs, because nothing is hot enough to matter.
bars.lazy: Natives graze and wander across open sand like vanilla animals, never visibly resting between runs, because nothing is hot enough to matter.

checks.what: Resolve effective XML/patch roster, animalDensity/plantDensity, diets, pack-animal whitelist, body/life stages and products; record values from the loaded build. No every-file pass gate.

Shared formula is 55 C at zenith times sin(elevation) and weather factor at default strength; identical geometry yields identical sun in control biome. Scan legacy per-biome fields as regression evidence.

Deferred rim thresholds MinRimShade=0.05 and MaxRimShade=0.85 are checks for optional T45 enablement, not bars. Default dewfringe spawn candidates ignore shade fraction and retain ordinary fertility/terrain eligibility.
Default, write, save, reload and reset every major-feature switch, including all future defaults; inspect active jobs/conditions after off. Correct Now/New local maps/Next pulse/Next load labels.
State-read absence/presence acceptance of T01..T34 and T45 plus clean log; preserve dormant defs/code/art and prevent active queued extras surviving a switch-off.
Existing LongShade kernel fuzz, planted-defect validation selftests and proof drivers are regression tools. Old counts/comments/clauses are stale where they demand deferred extras.
Calibration tolerances and matched-control attributions specified in models.md; a model not matching game is untrusted, never a game measurement.
Record geometry grid versions, sun vector, exposure layers, felt temperature, Heatstroke, job/path/target, food ingested, population event reasons and inspect/kill signs for bar evidence.
No RSW/campaign leakage into RM tier, no missing textures, all required DLC active, actual MaxFlightTime/motion for fictional flyers; keep protected art.
Ordinary scanner resolves actual targets, quiet text does not assert absence of hidden threats, and deferred heaps/cart/letters never become phantom readings.

Two work action orders and season reload checkpoints preserve causal outcomes; exact RNG continuation is checked when game serialization makes it deterministic, otherwise compare attributed events and qualitative regimes.
Report repeating exceptions and stuck-job/no-progress intervals with actor and cause; fixing a failed check may require fixing the tool. Judge rejects on failed experience bars alone.

rules.rule: Use the shared tile-to-sun geometry and ordinary felt-temperature/Heatstroke path. No LongShade heat kind, offset, elevation clamp or weather-driven shadow-length multiplier; keep the standing global formula rather than retune privately.
Real static, moving, roof and gear layers resolve through the shared grid; invalidate vacated/removed/dead sources. Perceived Mirrak shade is separate and cannot alter real exposure.

Healthy natives alternate shelter rest and brisk exposed crossings in ordinary default fixed-world conditions, including mild exposure; needs and failed hunts must obey thermal retreat when it can act. Colonists consume the absent shared CreatureBehaviors onset-of-Direct-Sun-overheating response specified in definition.md and T44: interrupt undrafted ordinary work, seek nearest reachable lower-exposure recovery refuge, then resume ordinary work after recovery. No LongShade work forecaster, social shade hierarchy, clockwork schedule or identical gait across species.

Dewfringe and its sprig remain ordinary forage life, using fertility/terrain recruitment at defaults and ordinary growth/death after shelter moves. The shade-fraction rim gate is next version, off under T45. No forced relocation, instant death or compulsory ring.

Keep all present roster memberships, including multi-homed Qorrax and campaign species; preserve exported defs and owner-kept art. Separate ordinary recruitment and birth from deferred seeding, and log attributable deaths/despawns.

Master/per-major-feature settings persist; default retained systems on, future extras off and labelled Next version, resets use those same defaults. Off stops new orders/effects and releases active owners safely; existing content remains loadable. No new cross-biome switch.
Use normal terrain affordances, vanilla building, parasols/any roof and shared salvage. Local map creation is not planetary worldgen; never repaint or roll an alternative planet.

Observe normal needs, weather and AI; qualify offline output with game calibration and use disposable scratch saves with durable cleanup manifests. Tests of a moved extra are checks and never refusal bars.
